name: Cera
sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Cera is an Irish god. The name belongs to the Dagda. It may signify creator. Scribes used it in texts and place-names.

okr.objective: Cera is an alternate name for the Irish god the Dagda.
key_results: Cera is a name given to the Dagda.
Cera appears in texts and place-names.
okr.evidence: Monaghan, Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore
